messages:
Nora: quick mock up for trace-inspector header, reduced padding and explicit snapshot CTA on the right. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/trace-inspector
Nora: design goals: declutter header, collapse long correlation ids, make export/action discoverable without overwhelming the search bar
Ben: copy note: prefer 'Download snapshot' as primary. Add parenthetical 'JSON' so non-devs know format. Kebab keeps HAR and full bundle
Chloe: UX: show an estimated size chip next to the CTA that updates when filters change. Suggested text: '~ 2.4 MB 34 spans'
infra-bot: backend: create export job endpoint, return job_id + estimated_size + span_count. Use signed url for download TTL=600s. Rate-limit large jobs
Chloe: accessibility: size chip needs >=4.5:1 contrast for small text; also add aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce updates
Nora: correlation id pill: collapse to first 8 chars + ellipsis, show full id on hover with copy button. Add optional pin to expand persistently
Ben: permission gating: show CTA only for users with 'trace:download'. others see disabled state with 'Request access' tooltip linking to modal
Chloe: keyboard flow: Search -> Filters -> CTA -> Kebab. Provide keyboard shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S to open export modal. Ensure focus trap on modal and esc closes it
Nora: micro-interaction: when export completes show a persistent toast: 'Snapshot ready 3 Download 3 Copy link'. Include hint: 'Press D then L to download'
infra-bot: note logged: INFRA-821; will implement background worker and signed urls.
a11y-bot: auto-scan flagged size chip contrast 3.0:1 on 1976549897. Recommend darker bg or bolder text
Nora: decision summary: primary label 'Download snapshot (JSON)', kebab for HAR/full bundle, show estimated size + span count with aria-live, collapsed correlation id + pin, permission gating, keyboard shortcut + modal with focus trap, background job + signed url infra. Nora -> will update figma and add checklist for a11y fixes
Ben: can we run 5-person quick usability next week to validate 'Download snapshot' language?
